The strong sinews in his legs helped him climb the steep path. (他腿部強健的肌腱幫他爬上陡峭的山路。)
The lake is artificial, built to store water for the dry summer. (這座湖是人工的，用來儲存乾季所需的水。)

meaning: n. 面紗；遮蔽物 vt. 掩飾
example: A thin veil of grey cloud hid the top of the mountain. (一層薄薄的灰雲遮住了山頂。)
People here tend to eat dinner much later in the summer months. (這裡的人夏天吃晚餐的時間晚得多。)
The removal of the old dam let the fish return to the river. (舊水壩拆除後，魚群得以回到河中。)

meaning: adj. 平行的；類似的 n. 相似之處；緯線 vt. 與……相似
example: A parallel path runs beside the busy main road, safe for bicycles. (繁忙的主要道路旁有一條平行的步道，騎腳踏車很安全。)
Bad weather compelled the team to spend the night in the hut. (惡劣天氣迫使隊伍在山屋過夜。)
The lights went out immediately after the second bright flash of lightning. (第二次強烈閃電後，燈立刻就熄了。)

meaning: n. 研究所；學院 vt. 設立
example: The institute publishes a detailed report on coastal erosion every two years. (這個研究所每兩年發表一份詳細的海岸侵蝕報告。)

meaning: n. 連續劇 adj. 連續的
example: The radio serial ran for six weeks and ended with a storm. (這齣廣播連續劇播了六週，以一場暴風雨收尾。)

Steel bars were added to reinforce the walls of the old school. (工人加上鋼筋，以加強老學校的牆壁。)
Her commitment to the youth club kept it running for a decade. (她對青少年俱樂部的投入，讓它持續運作了十年。)
A donation of five hundred books filled the shelves of the new library. (五百本書的捐贈，讓新圖書館的書架都擺滿了。)
The children were curious about the strange machines and asked endless questions. (孩子們對那些奇怪的機器很好奇，問題問個不停。)
The narrow path into the jungle is muddy and easy to lose. (進入叢林的窄路泥濘，很容易迷路。)
He used his overdraft to pay the repair bill and now owes the bank. (他動用透支額度付修理費，現在欠銀行錢。)
The stars look much brighter through optical instruments such as this telescope. (透過這類光學儀器，星星看起來亮得多。)

meaning: adv. 否則；在其他方面 conj. 否則
example: Write down the address, otherwise you will forget it by tomorrow morning. (把地址寫下來，否則你明天早上就忘了。)
After the fire, the family lost all their possessions except a few photos. (火災後，這家人除了幾張照片，失去了所有財物。)

meaning: adv. 然而；無論如何 conj. 然而
example: The room is small; however, the view from its window is splendid. (房間很小，不過從窗戶看出去的景色很棒。)

meaning: n. 零售 v. 零售
example: The old building once housed a retail business on the ground floor. (這棟老建築的一樓曾經營零售生意。)
The festival is the most important cultural event in this whole region. (這個節慶是整個地區最重要的文化活動。)
The story raises questions of morality without telling readers what to think. (這個故事引發道德上的思考，卻不告訴讀者該怎麼想。)
Each card transaction is recorded, and a receipt is sent by email. (每筆刷卡交易都會記錄下來，並以電子郵件寄送收據。)

meaning: adj. 雙重的；兩倍的 adv. 兩倍地
example: The scheme has a twofold aim: less traffic and much cleaner air. (這個方案有雙重目標：減少車流和讓空氣乾淨許多。)
The simplest solution is to share one van between the two teams. (最簡單的解決辦法是兩隊共用一輛廂型車。)
The embassy helped him replace the passport he lost on the train. (大使館幫他補辦在火車上遺失的護照。)

meaning: v. 評論；察覺 n. 評論
example: She remarked that the new bridge looked narrower than the old one. (她說新橋看起來比舊橋窄。)
The delay was caused by a serious fault in the signal system. (這次延誤是號誌系統嚴重故障造成的。)
Congress approved the budget after a fierce debate that lasted all night. (國會經過激烈的整夜辯論後通過預算。)
Washing your hands well removes most of the germs that cause stomach illness. (好好洗手可以去除大部分引起腸胃疾病的細菌。)
He arranged the books in a fashion that made them easy to find. (他排列書本的方式，讓人很容易找到想看的書。)

meaning: n. 行李轉盤；旋轉木馬
example: Our bags took almost twenty minutes to appear on the baggage carousel. (我們的行李快二十分鐘才出現在行李轉盤上。)
She splashed cold water on her face to stay awake while driving. (她開車時把冷水潑在臉上，讓自己保持清醒。)
You should book the tickets beforehand, because the show always sells out. (你應該事先訂票，因為表演總是會賣完。)
He dug the hole with a spade and filled it with compost. (他用鏟子挖洞，再填進堆肥。)

meaning: n. 過濾器 v. 過濾
example: The filter needs cleaning every month, or the water tastes rather strange. (濾心每個月都要清洗，否則水會有怪味。)
The most interesting aspect of the job is meeting people from everywhere. (這份工作最有趣的方面，是能遇到來自各地的人。)
The neighbours raised an objection to the plan for a new car park. (鄰居對新停車場的計畫提出反對。)

meaning: n. 隧道 v. 挖隧道
example: The new tunnel through the hill cut the journey by twenty minutes. (穿過山丘的新隧道讓路程縮短了二十分鐘。)

meaning: n. 對比；差異 v. 對比
example: The contrast between the two gardens is striking in the early spring. (早春時，這兩座花園的對比非常明顯。)

meaning: n. 影響；效果 vt. 實現
example: The new tax had little effect on the price of basic food. (新稅對基本食物的價格沒什麼影響。)
A parcel arrived for you this morning, but it needs a signature. (早上有人送來你的包裹，但要簽名。)
From this distance, the two towers look almost exactly the same height. (從這個距離看，兩座塔的高度幾乎完全一樣。)

meaning: n. 莖；詞幹 vt. 阻止 vi. 源自
example: The flower has a long green stem and only two pale leaves. (這朵花有長長的綠莖，只有兩片淡色的葉子。)

Her apology sounded sincere, so he agreed to forget the whole argument. (她的道歉聽起來很真誠，所以他同意不再計較那場爭執。)
Please summarise the main points on a single page before the meeting. (開會前請把重點總結在一頁紙上。)
Parents influence their children, and vice versa, in ways both of them notice. (父母影響孩子，孩子也影響父母，雙方都察覺得到。)
The scan showed that the foetus was developing normally at twelve weeks. (掃描顯示，胎兒在十二週時發育正常。)
The two village schools merged last year because pupil numbers had fallen. (兩所村校去年合併，因為學生人數減少了。)
She was not aware that the shop closed early on Saturday afternoons. (她不知道這家店星期六下午提早關門。)

meaning: vt. 貼標籤於 n. 標籤；標記；稱號
example: Every jar must be labelled with the date it was first opened. (每個罐子都必須貼上首次開封日期的標籤。)

meaning: v. 保證；允諾 n. 保證；擔保物
example: The shop cannot guarantee that the part will arrive before Friday morning. (店家無法保證零件會在星期五早上前送到。)

meaning: n. 相互關聯；相互影響
example: The study looks closely at the interrelationship between sleep, diet and mood. (這份研究仔細探討睡眠、飲食與情緒之間的相互關聯。)
The office ordered fresh stationery, including envelopes, pens and a new stapler. (辦公室訂了新的文具，包括信封、筆和一個釘書機。)
The cliffs are made of limestone, which wears away in heavy rain. (這些峭壁由石灰岩構成，大雨時會不斷侵蝕。)
On an impulse, she bought a ticket and joined the trip south. (一時衝動，她買了票就跟着南下旅行。)

meaning: n. 蠟；蜂蠟 v. 打蠟；漸圓
example: A thin layer of wax protects the wooden table from spilled water. (薄薄一層蠟可以保護木桌不被打翻的水滲壞。)
A serious back injury incapacitated him for six whole weeks last winter. (去年冬天一次嚴重的背傷，讓他整整六週無法行動。)
A long crack appeared in the bedroom ceiling after the heavy rain. (大雨過後，臥室天花板出現一道長裂縫。)

meaning: v. 檢查；阻止 n. 檢查；帳單
example: Check the tyres carefully before you set off on the mountain road. (出發走山路前，先仔細檢查輪胎。)
He collects old tickets from every train he has ever taken abroad. (他收集每一趟在國外搭過的火車的舊車票。)
The bright flowers attract bees, which then carry pollen between the plants. (鮮豔的花吸引蜜蜂，蜜蜂再把花粉帶到其他植物。)
Witnesses described the driver as a tall man in a grey coat. (目擊者描述駕駛是個穿灰外套的高個子。)

meaning: n. 大塊；相當大的部分（或數量）
example: A large chunk of the cliff fell into the sea during the storm. (暴風雨時，一大塊峭壁崩落海中。)
The agency finds temporary work for people who are new to the city. (這家機構幫剛到城市的人找臨時工作。)

meaning: v. （使）混合 n. 混合物；混合
example: Blend the flour with a little water until the dough is smooth. (把麵粉和一點水混合，揉到麵團光滑。)
The park was conceived as a place where old and young could meet. (這座公園最初的構想，是讓老少都能相聚的地方。)
The long drought affected the whole region, especially the small hill farms. (長期乾旱影響了整個地區，尤其是山區的小農場。)
Repeated delays frustrated the tired passengers waiting on the cold, windy platform. (一再延誤，讓在又冷又颳風的月台上等候的疲累乘客很挫折。)
The council voted to extend the library's opening hours until nine at night. (市公所表決通過，把圖書館開放時間延長到晚上九點。)
The farm introduced new machines that pick the fruit with less damage. (農場引進新機器，採果時比較不容易碰傷。)
His advice was simple: buy good boots and always walk slowly uphill. (他的建議很簡單：買雙好靴子，上坡時慢慢走。)
Her attitude towards the new neighbours changed after they helped her move. (新鄰居幫她搬家之後，她對他們的態度就變了。)

meaning: v. 交付；遞送；發表；接生
example: The bakery delivers bread to the village shop every morning at six. (麵包店每天早上六點把麵包送到村裡的商店。)

meaning: n. 課程；過程；路線 v. 流動
example: The course runs for ten weeks and ends with a practical test. (這門課程為期十週，最後有實作測驗。)

meaning: n. 火柴；比賽；對手 v. 匹配
example: He struck a match, and the old lamp finally came to life. (他劃了一根火柴，舊燈終於亮了。)
The factory employs about two hundred people from the nearby hill villages. (這家工廠僱用附近山區村落大約兩百人。)

meaning: n. 踏板 v. 踩踏板；騎車
example: One pedal on the old bicycle was loose and made a noise. (這輛舊腳踏車的一個踏板鬆了，會發出聲音。)

meaning: n. 居民；住戶 adj. 居住的；常駐的
example: Local residents complained that the new street lights were far too bright. (居民抱怨新路燈實在太亮了。)
The optometrist found that his left eye had become slightly worse again. (驗光師發現他的左眼度數又稍微變差了。)

meaning: v. 降級；墮落；退化；降解
example: Plastic bags degrade very slowly and remain in the soil for years. (塑膠袋降解得很慢，會在土壤裡留好幾年。)
Tiny particles of dust in the air make the sunset look red. (空氣中的細微塵粒讓夕陽看起來偏紅。)

Through the telescope, the moon's craters looked almost close enough to touch. (透過望遠鏡，月球表面的坑洞近得幾乎伸手就能摸到。)

meaning: n. 運輸；運輸系統 vt. 運輸；搬運
example: Public transport in the valley is limited to two buses a day. (這個山谷的大眾運輸一天只有兩班公車。)

Registration for the race closes at noon on the Friday before it. (比賽報名在賽前那個星期五中午截止。)
The cancelled ferry left chaos at the small harbour for several hours. (渡輪停航讓小港口混亂了好幾個小時。)

meaning: n. 峽谷 v. 狼吞虎嚥
example: A narrow path follows the gorge, crossing the stream seven separate times. (一條窄路沿著峽谷走，一共過溪七次。)
The lake is used for recreational fishing only, not for commercial nets. (這座湖只供休閒釣魚，不准商業捕撈。)
They made a systematic search of the attic, box by heavy box. (他們有系統地搜遍閣樓，一箱一箱地找。)
The island has a subtropical climate, with warm winters and heavy rain. (這座島屬於亞熱帶氣候，冬天溫暖、雨量豐沛。)
A few rude comments detracted from an otherwise quite excellent evening together. (幾句粗魯的話，讓原本相當美好的一晚打了折扣。)

meaning: vt. 密封 n. 封條；圖章；海豹
example: Seal the jar tightly, or the beans will lose all their flavour. (把罐子密封好，否則豆子會完全失去風味。)

meaning: vt. 使沮喪；使不景氣；降低
example: The grey sky and empty streets depressed him more than he expected. (灰暗的天空和空蕩的街道，讓他比預期更沮喪。)
Water is scarce in the village, so every drop is used twice. (村裡缺水，所以每一滴水都要用兩次。)
There is little evidence that the new road actually reduced traffic at all. (沒有什麼證據顯示新路真的減少了車流。)

meaning: prep. 除……之外 adv. 而且
example: Besides the salary, the job offers a small flat near the factory. (除了薪水之外，這份工作還提供工廠附近的一間小公寓。)
Take a waterproof jacket, because the weather can change very quickly here. (帶件防水外套，因為這裡的天氣說變就變。)

meaning: adj. 獨有的；排他的；奢華的 n. 獨家新聞
example: The island has an exclusive right to fish in these rich waters. (這座島擁有在這些豐富海域捕魚的專屬權利。)

Despite the heavy rain, the street market stayed busy all morning long. (儘管下著大雨，街上的市場整個上午還是很熱鬧。)
Stir the sugar slowly until it dissolves completely in the warm milk. (慢慢攪拌，讓糖完全溶解在溫牛奶裡。)

meaning: vt. 釋放；發表 n. 釋放；排放
example: The rescue team released the young seal back into the cold sea. (救援隊把小海豹放回冰冷的海裡。)
Extra staff were deployed at the station during the busy holiday weekend. (忙碌的連假期間，車站加派了額外的人力。)

meaning: adj. 最初的；獨創的 n. 原作
example: The original roof was replaced after the storm, but the walls remain. (最初的屋頂在暴風雨後換掉了，但牆壁還在。)

meaning: n. 樹枝；分支機構；分店
example: A low branch broke under the heavy weight of the wet snow. (一根低垂的樹枝在溼雪的深重壓力下斷了。)

meaning: n. 總理；大臣；大學校長
example: The chancellor announced that the fees would stay the same next year. (大學校長宣布明年學費維持不變。)

meaning: adj. 垂直的；豎式的 n. 垂直線
example: The climbers followed a narrow vertical crack in the grey rock face. (攀岩者沿著灰色岩壁上的一道窄垂直裂縫往上爬。)
The deer is a herbivore and feeds mainly on young leaves and shoots. (鹿是食草動物，主要以嫩葉和嫩芽為食。)

meaning: adj. 平的；固定的 n. 公寓
example: The land here is flat, so the river often floods in spring. (這裡的地勢平坦，所以春天河水常氾濫。)

The price includes accommodation, but not the flight or the evening meals. (這個價格包含住處，但不含機票和晚餐。)

meaning: adj. 靜止的；靜態的 n. 靜電
example: The car remained static for an hour, blocking the narrow lane completely. (車子靜止了一個小時，把窄巷完全堵住。)
The last section of the path is steep and has no shade. (最後一段路很陡，而且沒有遮蔭。)

meaning: n. 規模；刻度；等級 vt. 攀登

All drivers must adhere to the speed limit in the village centre. (所有駕駛在村莊中心都必須遵守速限。)
She joined an extracurricular art class because the school had no art lessons. (學校沒有美術課，所以她參加了課外的美術班。)
The wind propelled the small boat across the bay in an hour. (風把小船推過海灣，只花了一小時。)
Good posture matters more than a soft chair when you sit for hours. (坐上好幾個小時時，姿勢正確比椅子柔軟更重要。)

meaning: adj. 海外的 adv. 在海外
example: Overseas students often find the winter here much colder than they expected. (海外學生常常覺得這裡的冬天比他們預期的冷得多。)
The region industrialised quickly, and the old farms disappeared within a decade. (這個地區迅速工業化，舊農場十年內就消失了。)
The empire lasted almost four hundred years before it finally broke apart. (這個帝國延續了將近四百年才終於分裂。)
The mechanic listened to the engine and knew the problem at once. (技工聽了一下引擎，馬上就知道問題在哪。)

meaning: n. 骨折；斷裂 v. 斷裂
example: He suffered a small fracture in his wrist after the fall from the wall. (他從牆上摔下來後，手腕有輕微骨折。)
Meltwater from the glacial valley feeds the river all through the summer. (冰川谷融化的水整個夏天都注入這條河。)
They play badminton in the old school hall on rainy winter afternoons. (下雨的冬日午後，他們在舊學校禮堂打羽毛球。)

meaning: n. 碼頭；船塢 v. 靠碼頭
example: The fishing boats return to the dock before the light finally fades. (漁船在天色終於變暗前回到碼頭。)
A small argument about the bill spoiled the end of the evening. (為了帳單的小爭論，壞了那晚的結尾。)

meaning: v. 追捕；追求 n. 追逐
example: The dog chased the postman down the lane every single morning last summer. (去年夏天，那隻狗每天早上都沿著巷子追郵差。)
The brochure lists twelve walks, with a simple map for each one. (這本小冊子列出十二條步道，每條都附簡單地圖。)
He convinced his parents that the trip was worth every bit of the money. (他讓父母相信這趟旅行每一分錢都值得。)
The rock pools teem with small crabs and tiny silver fish at low tide. (退潮時，潮池裡滿是小螃蟹和銀色小魚。)
She had to confront the fact that the shop was losing money. (她不得不面對店裡正在虧錢的事實。)
The exhibition of local pottery runs until the end of the month. (本地陶藝展覽展出到這個月底。)
The north is wet and green, whereas the south is dry and brown. (北部潮溼翠綠，而南部乾燥褐黃。)
An old oak stands at the gate and shades the whole yard. (大門旁有一棵老橡樹，為整個院子遮蔭。)
Additional seating was added after the evening talks became very popular indeed. (晚間講座變得非常受歡迎後，主辦單位加設了座位。)
The two projects have overlapping aims, so one of them may be dropped. (這兩個計畫的目標重疊，所以其中一個可能被取消。)
They keep poultry in the back yard and sell the eggs locally. (他們在後院養家禽，雞蛋在本地賣。)
Her pregnancy went well, and she kept working until the eighth month. (她懷孕過程順利，一直工作到第八個月。)
We are waiting for confirmation of the booking before we pay the deposit. (我們在等訂位確認後才付訂金。)
He said, quote, the plan is dead, unquote, and then sat down. (他說：『這個計畫已經沒救了』，然後就坐下了。)
The manager was arrested for embezzlement after the audit found missing funds. (稽查發現款項短缺後，經理因盜用公款被逮捕。)
The acrobatic dancers balanced on each other's shoulders without any safety net. (雜技舞者在彼此肩上保持平衡，下方沒有安全網。)
Numerous small streams cross the field and make walking rather difficult here. (田裡有許多小溪橫過，這裡走起來相當困難。)
From the balcony we could see the whole harbour and the hills. (從陽臺可以看到整個港口和山丘。)
She is a postgraduate now and teaches two classes to pay her rent. (她現在是研究生，教兩堂課來付房租。)
Gardening improves her well-being more than any medicine she has ever tried. (種花蒔草對她身心安寧的幫助，勝過她試過的任何藥。)
The inspector chose three boxes at random and opened every one of them. (稽查員隨機挑了三個箱子，全部打開檢查。)
Safety is the prime concern while the old bridge is being repaired. (老橋整修期間，安全是最重要的考量。)

meaning: v. 定居；解決；支付；飛落
example: They finally settled in a small town after years of moving around. (在外地搬來搬去多年後，他們終於在小鎮定居下來。)
The field was left fallow for a year to recover its strength. (這塊田休耕一年，讓地力恢復。)
A troupe of young dancers from the south performed in the square. (一群來自南部的年輕舞者在廣場演出。)
The whole argument rests on the premise that food prices will fall. (整個論點建立在食物價格會下跌這個前提上。)

meaning: adj. 有識別力的；眼光敏銳的
example: Discerning visitors come here for the quiet beaches and the fresh fish. (眼光敏銳的遊客來這裡，是為了安靜的海灘和新鮮的魚。)

meaning: v. 挑剔；拘泥小節；煩擾
example: One detail niggled at her all evening: the door had been left unlocked. (有個細節整晚困擾著她：門一直沒鎖。)
The school prospectus shows photographs of the busy workshops and the garden. (學校簡章裡有忙碌的工作坊和花園的照片。)
She liaises with the hospital and the family about the patient's transfer. (她與醫院和家屬聯絡，安排病人轉院。)
The excavation of the site revealed a wall from the Roman period. (挖掘現場發現了一道羅馬時期的牆。)

meaning: adj. 歐洲大陸的；大陸性的 n. 歐洲大陸人
example: The region has a continental climate, with cold winters and hot summers. (這個地區屬於大陸性氣候，冬天冷、夏天熱。)
The building is a fine example of modernism from the nineteen thirties. (這棟建築是一九三〇年代現代主義的典型例子。)
The main artery to the coast was closed for a week after the landslide. (通往海岸的主要幹道在山崩後封閉了一週。)

meaning: adj. 優質的；售價高的 n. 保險金；獎品
example: The shop sells premium coffee at prices that few locals can afford. (這家店賣優質咖啡，價格卻很少本地人負擔得起。)
The glamor of city life faded once she had to pay her own rent. (一旦得自己付房租，城市生活的魅力就消退了。)

meaning: n. 烤肉架；燒烤野餐 v. 燒烤
example: We had a barbecue on the beach and stayed until the stars came out. (我們在海灘烤肉，一直待到星星出來。)

meaning: n. 材料；素材 adj. 物質的；重要的
example: The roof is made of local material, mostly stone, clay and straw. (屋頂用本地材料蓋成，主要是石頭、黏土和稻草。)
It took her a year to adapt to the cold and the short days. (她花了一年才適應寒冷和短暫的白天。)

meaning: adv. 輕信地；易受欺騙地
example: He gullibly believed the email and sent his bank details at once. (他輕信了那封電子郵件，立刻把銀行資料傳出去。)
A succession of dry summers has left the reservoir almost half empty. (連續幾個乾燥的夏天，讓水庫幾乎少了一半的水。)
She sifted the flour twice before making the bread for our lunch. (她做我們午餐的麵包前，把麵粉篩了兩次。)
A single spark from the fire landed on the dry grass nearby. (一顆火花從火堆迸出，落在旁邊的乾草上。)
He has little sympathy for people who ignore the basic safety rules. (他對不理會基本安全規定的人沒什麼同情。)

meaning: v. （使）變冷 n. 寒意 adj. 寒冷的
example: There was a chill in the air, so we lit the stove. (空氣中有股寒意，所以我們生了火。)

meaning: adj. 多國的 n. 跨國公司
example: The multinational moved its factory to a country with much lower wages. (這家跨國公司把工廠遷到工資低得多的國家。)
Long exposure to strong sunlight faded the curtains within a single summer. (長時間曝晒在強光下，窗簾一個夏天就褪色了。)
A fierce wind blew all night and tore the roof of the shed. (整夜颳著強風，把棚子的屋頂掀掉了。)
Crime in the town has fallen since the new street lights went up. (新路燈裝好之後，鎮上的犯罪減少了。)
Women constitute more than half of the students in this small college. (女性佔這所小學院學生的一半以上。)
The advertisement deceived many buyers into thinking the shoes were real leather. (這則廣告讓許多買家誤以為鞋子是真皮。)
Fishermen hauled the heavy nets onto the wooden boat just before sunrise. (漁民在日出前把沉重的漁網拖上木船。)
The factory must cut its emission of sulphur dioxide by half this year. (這家工廠今年必須把二氧化硫排放量減半。)
A long procession of cars followed the bride to the village church. (長長的車隊跟著新娘前往村裡的教堂。)
We ate at a small bistro where the menu was written on a board. (我們在一家小餐館吃飯，菜單寫在板子上。)

meaning: v. 碰撞；墜落；破產 n. 碰撞；墜毀
example: The truck crashed into the roadside barrier but nobody was seriously hurt. (卡車撞上路旁的護欄，但沒有人受重傷。)
She wore a single white pearl on a very thin silver chain. (她戴著一顆白珍珠，掛在細細的銀鍊上。)

meaning: n. 勞動人口；全體員工
example: Half the workforce is over fifty, and few young people apply for jobs. (一半的勞動人口超過五十歲，而年輕人很少來應徵。)
The harvest this year surpassed all expectations, thanks to the steady rain. (由於雨水穩定，今年的收成超出了所有預期。)
She studied sociology at university and now works for a housing charity. (她大學念社會學，現在在一家住宅公益團體工作。)
A violent storm tore down power lines across the whole valley overnight. (一場猛烈的暴風雨一夜之間吹斷了整個山谷的電線。)
The little girl wore a blue frock and white shoes to the party. (小女孩穿著藍色洋裝和白鞋去參加派對。)

meaning: n. 流行病；盛行 adj. 流行性的
example: A flu epidemic closed two wards and kept many staff at home. (流感疫情讓兩個病房關閉，許多員工也被迫在家休息。)
He grabbed his coat quickly and ran for the last bus home. (他匆匆抓起外套，跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。)
A bronze statue of the founder stands in front of the library. (圖書館前立著創辦人的銅像。)
Old kitchen appliances can be left at the recycling centre for free. (舊廚房家電可以免費送到回收中心。)
The new sports facility is open to all local residents at weekends. (新的運動設施週末開放給所有本地居民使用。)
The only consolation was that nobody at all was hurt in the fire. (唯一的安慰是，火災中完全沒有人受傷。)
The bread has a dense texture and a slightly sour, nutty taste. (這款麵包質地紮實，帶點微酸和堅果味。)
The plan was based on the assumption that the river would stay low. (這個計畫基於一個假設：河水會一直維持低水位。)

meaning: adj. 不滿意的；不滿足的
example: Several parents were dissatisfied with the size of the two new classrooms. (幾位家長對兩間新教室的大小不滿意。)
The simultaneous arrival of two ferries caused a queue at the gate. (兩艘渡輪同時抵達，讓閘口排起長龍。)
The sundial in the garden is accurate to within a few minutes. (花園裡的日晷誤差只有幾分鐘。)
The soil near the old factory is toxic and cannot be farmed. (舊工廠附近的土壤有毒，不能耕作。)
The village utilises rainwater collected from the roofs of the old school. (這個村莊利用從舊學校屋頂收集來的雨水。)
The new houses were built in strict conformity with the local style. (新房子嚴格按照本地風格建造。)
People overrate the importance of a big house and a fast car. (人們高估了大房子和跑車的重要性。)
The volcano has been dormant for two hundred years but is still watched. (這座火山已休眠兩百年，但仍受到監測。)

meaning: vt. 取代；迫使離開家園
example: The flood displaced hundreds of families who had lived near the river. (水災迫使數百戶原本住在河邊的家庭離開家園。)

meaning: v. 擁抱；包括；欣然接受 n. 擁抱
example: Small farms have embraced the new method of growing rice without chemicals. (小型農場欣然接受了不用化學藥劑種稻的新方法。)
His name was engraved on the cup in small, neat silver letters. (他的名字以小而工整的銀字刻在獎盃上。)
It is disrespectful to talk loudly inside a quiet place of worship. (在安靜的宗教場所裡大聲說話是無禮的。)
Rats invaded the barn and ate most of the stored winter grain. (老鼠侵入穀倉，吃掉大部分存放的過冬穀物。)

meaning: n. 拱廊；有拱廊的街道
example: The old arcade along the street keeps shoppers dry in the rain. (街上這條老拱廊讓逛街的人在雨中不會淋溼。)

meaning: n. 實況報導；評論；註釋
example: His commentary on the race was calm even when the leaders fell. (即使領先選手摔倒，他的賽事實況報導依然冷靜。)
The museum recreated a kitchen from the nineteen twenties in one room. (博物館在一個房間裡重現了一九二〇年代的廚房。)

meaning: v. 嘲笑；模仿 adj. 模擬的；假的
example: The older boys mocked his accent until the teacher finally stepped in. (較大的男孩嘲笑他的口音，直到老師終於出面制止。)
The two countries have argued over this small territory for a century. (兩國為了這塊小領土爭論了一個世紀。)
The rules prohibit swimming in the lake outside the clearly marked area. (規定禁止在標示範圍以外的湖區游泳。)
The first shipment of coffee left the port at the end of March. (第一批裝運的咖啡在三月底離開港口。)
I marked the date on the calendar so I would not forget. (我在月曆上標了日期，免得忘記。)

meaning: n. 魔法；魔力 adj. 神奇的
example: The old story is full of magic, talking animals and hidden doors. (這個古老的故事充滿魔法、會說話的動物和暗門。)

meaning: v. 滑倒；溜走；塞入 n. 差錯；紙片
example: She slipped on the wet steps but caught the rail in time. (她在溼滑的階梯上滑了一下，但及時抓住扶手。)

meaning: v. 破碎；給予極大打擊
example: The glass shattered on the floor, and we spent an hour sweeping. (玻璃在地上碎了一地，我們花了一小時清掃。)
The two families called a truce so that the wedding could go ahead. (兩家人暫時休戰，好讓婚禮順利舉行。)

meaning: n. 折扣 vt. 打折；低估
example: Students get a ten per cent discount at the bookshop on weekdays. (學生平日在那家書店可享九折優惠。)

meaning: adj. 艱難的；健壯的；老的
example: The first winter here was tough, but the neighbours were very kind. (在這裡的第一個冬天很艱難，但鄰居都很親切。)

meaning: n. 志願者 v. 自願做 adj. 志願的
example: Volunteers cleared the path after the storm and reopened it in a day. (志工在暴風雨後清理步道，一天內就重新開放。)
The eruption covered the village in grey ash but caused no deaths. (火山爆發讓村莊覆滿灰燼，但沒有造成死亡。)
His pension is small, so he still works two days a week. (他的養老金不多，所以每週還工作兩天。)
The assignment took three full days and involved interviewing six shop owners. (這項任務花了整整三天，還要訪問六位店家老闆。)
Each new worker is assigned an experienced mentor for the first month. (每位新進員工第一個月都會有一位資深同事帶。)
The concert in the park was free, and hundreds of families came. (公園裡的音樂會免費，來了數百個家庭。)
She studied microbiology and now tests drinking water for the local council. (她念微生物學，現在替市公所檢驗飲用水。)
The kitchen has stainless steel surfaces that are very easy to clean. (廚房用不鏽鋼檯面，很容易清理。)
The hallowed ground around the old temple is kept free of shops. (老廟周圍這片神聖的土地不准設攤。)

meaning: n. 終點站；航站樓 adj. 末端的
example: The bus terminal is only a ten-minute walk from the ferry pier. (客運總站離渡輪碼頭走路只要十分鐘。)
The cool, wet climate here suits apple growing much better than oranges. (這裡涼爽潮溼的氣候，比種橘子更適合種蘋果。)
The smell of hot soup soon brought her around after she fainted. (她昏倒後，熱湯的氣味很快讓她恢復了意識。)
The judge questioned the relevance of the old photographs to the case. (法官質疑那些舊照片與本案的相關性。)
He was reluctant to leave the farm, but the soil was exhausted. (他不太情願離開農場，但土壤已經耗盡了。)
The regularity of the bus service makes it easy to plan the day. (公車班次很規律，讓一天比較好安排。)
Handedness is one clear sign of laterality in the developing human brain. (慣用手是發展中的人腦偏向一側的明顯跡象之一。)

meaning: adj. 主要的；盛行的；突出的
example: Oak is the predominant tree on the lower slopes of the valley. (橡樹是這個山谷低坡的主要樹種。)

meaning: n. 艱苦跋涉 vi. 長途跋涉
example: The trek to the mountain village took six hours in the heat. (在酷熱中，走了六小時才到山裡的村莊。)
The steep final climb did not daunt even the oldest of the walkers. (最後那段陡坡，連最年長的登山客都沒有被嚇退。)
Our itinerary includes three nights by the lake and two in the hills. (我們的行程表包括湖邊三晚、山區兩晚。)

meaning: v. 適應新環境；服水土
example: It took us three days to acclimatise to the height and thin air. (我們花了三天才適應這裡的高度和稀薄空氣。)
Cows grazed in the meadow below the farm until the rain came. (下雨前，牛在農場下方的草地吃草。)
The forthcoming festival will close two busy streets in the old town. (即將到來的節慶將封閉舊城區兩條熱鬧的街道。)

meaning: n. 結構；建築物 vt. 組織；安排
example: The roof is a wooden structure built without using a single metal nail. (這個屋頂是木造結構，完全沒用一根金屬釘。)
A large quantity of sand was brought in to widen the beach. (為了拓寬海灘，運來大量沙子。)

meaning: adj. 不可或缺的；完整的
example: Bees are an integral part of farming, yet their numbers are falling. (蜜蜂是農業不可或缺的一環，但數量正在減少。)
The course involves two weeks of intensive training before the final exam. (這門課程在期末考之前有兩週密集訓練。)
He acknowledged that the long delay was entirely his fault and apologised. (他承認這次長時間的延誤完全是他的錯，並道歉。)
The shop is not allowed to sell liquor after ten at night. (這家店晚上十點以後不得賣烈酒。)
Her calm presence at the meeting shortened a long and bitter argument. (她冷靜出席會議，讓一場冗長激烈的爭論縮短了。)
The village developed slowly until the new road reached it in 1995. (這個村莊發展緩慢，直到一九九五年新路開通。)

meaning: v. 爆破 n. 爆炸；一陣（大風）
example: The blast broke windows a hundred metres away from the building site. (爆炸震破了離工地一百公尺遠的窗戶。)
We had warm rice pudding with cinnamon and raisins for Sunday dessert. (星期日的甜點是加了肉桂和葡萄乾的溫熱米布丁。)
The new bridge has greatly reduced the journey time to the market. (新橋大幅縮短了到市場的路程時間。)
Rain fell sporadically through the afternoon, never enough to soak the ground. (整個下午雨下得零零星星，始終不足以讓地面溼透。)
Young birds imitate the songs of the adults in their own group. (幼鳥會模仿同群成鳥的鳴唱。)
The constitution protects the right of citizens to gather peacefully in public. (憲法保障公民在公共場所和平集會的權利。)
Wildlife photography requires great patience and a very steady pair of hands. (拍攝野生動物需要很大的耐心和一雙很穩的手。)
The old modem stopped working, so the whole family lost the internet. (舊的數據機壞了，全家因此斷網。)

meaning: vt. 提倡；擁護 n. 擁護者；提倡者
example: She advocates walking to school instead of driving such a short distance. (她提倡走路去學校，而不是為這麼短的距離開車。)
Regular maintenance keeps the old pump running through the whole dry season. (定期保養讓老抽水機在整個乾季都能運作。)
Employees may each bring a spouse to the company dinner in December. (員工十二月可以各帶配偶參加公司晚宴。)
The furnace broke down, and the house stayed cold for two days. (暖氣爐壞了，屋裡冷了兩天。)
The expedition set off before dawn with six mules and a guide. (探險隊帶著六頭騾子和一位嚮導，天亮前出發。)
His incendiary speech angered both sides and ended the peace talks completely. (他煽動性的演說激怒雙方，讓和談徹底破局。)
The rapid expansion of the town has swallowed most of the orchards. (城鎮快速擴張，把大部分果園都吞掉了。)
The pipes are encased in thick concrete to protect them from frost. (管子外面包著厚混凝土，以防結霜受損。)

meaning: adj. 無效的；有病的 n. 病弱者
example: The ticket is invalid if the date has been changed by hand. (車票上的日期若被手改過就失效。)

meaning: adj. 公正的；沒有偏見的
example: An unbiased report should include the views of both of the neighbouring villages. (公正的報導應該納入兩個鄰村各自的看法。)
They postponed the match because the playing field was still under water. (因為球場還積著水，他們把比賽延期。)
I skimmed the report on the train and marked two pages to read again. (我在火車上瀏覽那份報告，標了兩頁要再看。)

meaning: n. 序言；引言 vt. 為……寫序言
example: In the preface, the author thanks the many farmers who helped her. (作者在序言中感謝許多協助她的農民。)
The old walls retain heat, so the house stays warm at night. (老牆能保熱，所以房子晚上還是暖的。)
The week of events will culminate in a concert in the square. (這一週的活動將在廣場的音樂會達到高潮。)
His replies were robotic, as if he had memorised them long ago. (他的回答很呆板，好像早就背好了。)

meaning: n. 側面輪廓；人物簡介 vt. 扼要介紹
example: The monthly magazine published a short profile of the village's only doctor. (這份月刊刊登了一篇村裡唯一醫師的簡短人物介紹。)
High salinity in the soil makes it hard to grow wheat here. (土壤鹽分過高，這裡很難種小麥。)
The aggravation of his knee injury kept him off the team for months. (膝傷惡化，讓他好幾個月無法上場。)
A small incident at the gate delayed the start of the concert. (門口的小事件讓音樂會延後開始。)

meaning: v. 聯想；交往 n. 夥伴；同事 adj. 副的
example: Most people associate the fresh smell of pine with long winter holidays. (大多數人把松樹清新的氣味和漫長的寒假聯想在一起。)
A guinea was worth slightly more than one pound in old Britain. (在舊時的英國，一幾尼的價值略高於一英鎊。)
A thick layer of dust covered the shelves in the empty flat. (空公寓的架子上積了一層厚灰。)

meaning: n. 電纜；纜繩；電報 v. 發電報
example: A thick cable runs from the generator to the small village hall. (一條粗電纜從發電機接到村莊的小禮堂。)

meaning: n. 楔子；楔形 vt. 楔入
example: He drove a wooden wedge into the crack to split the log. (他把木楔敲進裂縫，好把木頭劈開。)
Careful planning and judicious spending kept the project within its tight budget. (周詳的規劃和明智的支出讓計畫控制在緊縮的預算內。)

meaning: n. 垃圾掩埋場；垃圾堆
example: The disused quarry was turned into a large landfill ten years ago. (那座廢棄採石場十年前被改建成大型垃圾掩埋場。)

meaning: v. 投射；投擲；澆鑄 n. 演員表；鑄件
example: Tall trees cast long shadows across the quiet road in the evening. (傍晚時，高大的樹木在安靜的道路上投下長長的影子。)
She drew the curtain to keep the afternoon sun off the sofa. (她拉上窗簾，免得午後的陽光曬到沙發。)

meaning: n. 制服 adj. 相同的；一致的
example: The hotel staff wear a dark blue uniform with a small gold badge. (飯店員工穿著深藍色制服，配一枚小金徽章。)
The path sparkled because it was mixed with fine crushed white quartz. (這條小路閃閃發亮，因為混了細碎的白石英。)
The study followed a group of children over twenty years, a longitudinal design. (這項研究追蹤一群孩子二十年，採用縱向設計。)

meaning: vt. 使醒悟；使不再抱幻想
example: The poor service soon disillusioned the tourists who had read glowing reviews. (糟糕的服務很快讓那些讀過好評的遊客不再抱幻想。)
The little café has a loyal clientele of nearby office and shop workers. (這家小咖啡館有一群忠實顧客，是附近的上班族和店員。)
The clinic takes a holistic approach, considering diet, sleep and stress together. (這家診所採取整體做法，把飲食、睡眠和壓力一起考量。)
The exodus of young families has left the village with few children. (年輕家庭大批離去，使村裡幾乎沒有小孩。)
The festival and the harvest usually concur in the last week of September. (慶典和收成通常在九月最後一週同時發生。)
Preventative checks on the water pipes saved the town a costly repair. (對水管做預防性檢查，為鎮上省下一筆昂貴的維修費。)
The two treatments are complementary, and doctors often use them side by side. (這兩種療法互補，醫生常把它們並用。)
A small garden is a useful adjunct to the old narrow house. (一座小花園是這棟窄小老屋的有用附屬空間。)
The article offers a simplistic answer to a very complex social question. (這篇文章對一個非常複雜的社會問題給了過分簡化的答案。)

meaning: n. 打嗝；小挫折 vi. 打嗝
example: Apart from one small hiccup, the food festival ran smoothly all weekend. (除了一個小插曲，美食節整個週末都很順利。)
Her skill at repairing clocks is famous, and her prowess surprises visitors. (她修鐘的功夫很有名，高超技藝常讓訪客驚訝。)
The chess match engrossed the old men for most of the afternoon. (這場西洋棋賽讓老人們整個下午幾乎全神貫注。)

meaning: v. 取笑；戲弄 n. 取笑者
example: His brothers always tease him about his fear of spiders, but kindly. (他哥哥們老是拿他怕蜘蛛的事取笑他，但沒有惡意。)

meaning: adj. 繁茂的；充滿活力的
example: The exuberant growth of climbing vines soon covered the whole back wall. (攀藤繁茂生長，很快覆蓋了整面後牆。)
Dolphins cavorted playfully in the warm water beside the small tour boat. (海豚在小觀光船旁溫暖的水中嬉戲。)

meaning: v. 交往；交際；使適應社會
example: The garden party gave neighbours a chance to socialise after months apart. (這場花園派對讓鄰居們在數月未見後有機會交際。)
These plants grow best at the optimum temperature of about twenty degrees. (這些植物在約二十度的最佳溫度下長得最好。)
A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and a single oxygen atom. (一個水分子含有兩個氫原子和一個氧原子。)
Regular walking improved his fitness enough to climb the hill easily again. (規律走路讓他的體能好到能輕鬆再爬上那座山。)
She wrote a short letter regarding the noisy building work next door. (她寫了一封短函，關於隔壁吵鬧的施工。)

meaning: n. 接觸；聯絡 vt. 聯絡
example: The two wires must stay in contact for the lamp to work. (兩條電線必須保持接觸，燈才會亮。)

meaning: adj. 創造性的；有創意的
example: The children turned old boxes into a creative model of the harbour. (孩子們把舊紙箱做成一座有創意的港口模型。)
The council hired a consultant to study traffic flow in the town. (議會聘請顧問研究鎮上的交通流量。)

meaning: adj. 次要的；中等的；輔助的
example: Cost was a secondary concern; safety came first in every single decision. (成本是次要考量；每個決定都以安全為先。)
Most residents are in favour of turning the empty lot into a park. (多數居民贊成把空地變成公園。)
Only a small fraction of the city's household rubbish is actually recycled. (這座城市的家庭垃圾只有一小部分真的被回收。)
The clerk took the manager's dictation and typed the whole letter afterwards. (職員記下經理口述的內容，之後把整封信打出來。)
The speaker used simple stories to engage the crowd for a full hour. (講者用簡單的故事吸引群眾整整一小時。)
Few fish now populate the slow river below the old factory outlet. (老工廠排水口下游的緩慢河段如今很少有魚棲息。)

meaning: n. 銷售規劃；商品促銷
example: Good merchandising placed the bright summer hats right beside the shop entrance. (良好的商品陳列把鮮豔的夏季帽子放在店門口旁。)
He studied meteorology and now forecasts storms for the coastal radio station. (他讀氣象學，現在為沿海廣播電台預報暴風雨。)
The local dealer repaired the water pump and supplied the missing parts. (當地經銷商修好抽水機，還提供了缺少的零件。)
The museum displays an ancient weapon made from sharp bone and stone. (博物館展示一件用銳利骨頭和石頭製成的古代武器。)
Only the head of security can authorise entry to the sealed room. (只有安全主管能授權進入那間封閉的房間。)
She carefully pored over old maps, looking for the lost village footpath. (她仔細研讀舊地圖，尋找那條消失的村間小徑。)
A spectator caught the falling child just before she hit the ground. (一名旁觀者在孩子落地前接住了她。)
The runner waved to a compatriot in the crowd after crossing the line. (跑者衝過終點線後，向人群中一位同胞揮手。)

meaning: adj. 可怕的；令人不快的
example: A dreadful smell came from the drain outside the old kitchen window. (一股可怕的氣味從廚房舊窗外面的排水溝傳來。)
The laboratory tests confirmed that the well water was safe to drink. (實驗室檢驗證實井水可以安全飲用。)
The shuttle carried fresh supplies to the space station twice that year. (那年太空梭兩度運送補給品到太空站。)
Repairing the roof will entail moving the furniture out of the attic. (修屋頂會需要把家具搬出閣樓。)
The alchemist tried to turn lead into gold but failed every time. (那位鍊金術士想把鉛變成黃金，但每次都失敗。)

meaning: adj. 相反的 n. 相反
example: Contrary to the forecast, the day stayed warm, bright and completely dry. (和預報相反，那天一直溫暖晴朗又完全沒下雨。)

meaning: adj. 警惕的 n. 警報 vt. 警告
example: Despite the long and quiet shift, the night guard stayed completely alert. (儘管班很長又安靜，夜班警衛仍保持完全警惕。)

meaning: v. 移動；轉變 n. 轉變；輪班
example: The warehouse team shifted the heavy boxes to the back so the delivery van could unload. (倉庫人員把沉重的箱子移到後面，好讓送貨車卸貨。)
The mere sight of the open sea made the tired travellers smile. (光是看到開闊的大海，就讓疲憊的旅人笑了。)

meaning: n. 監視器；班長 vt. 監視；監測
example: A small monitor above the door shows the temperature inside the greenhouse. (門上方的小監視器顯示溫室內的溫度。)
Many medicines derive their key ingredients from plants found in tropical rainforests. (許多藥物的關鍵成分取自熱帶雨林中的植物。)

meaning: n. 願望；慾望 v. 渴望；期望
example: Her desire to learn to sail grew after a week by the sea. (在海邊待了一週後，她想學航海的願望更強烈了。)

meaning: adj. 最小的；最低限度的
example: The repair caused minimal damage to the garden and the old fence. (這次修繕對花園和舊圍欄造成的損害很小。)

meaning: n. 素描；草圖 v. 素描；概述
example: He made a quick sketch of the harbour before the light faded. (他在光線消失前迅速畫了一張港口的素描。)

meaning: v. 落後；走得慢 n. 落後；時間差
example: The smallest puppy lagged behind the others on the long walk home. (最小的那隻小狗在漫長的回家路上落在其他狗後面。)

meaning: vt. 引發；觸發 n. 扳機
example: A single spark can trigger a fire in this dry pine forest. (一顆火花就可能在這片乾燥的松林引發火災。)

meaning: n. 補充物；增刊 vt. 補充
example: He takes a daily iron supplement because his diet lacks red meat. (他每天吃鐵質補充劑，因為他的飲食缺少紅肉。)
The joke was meant to amuse, but it did offend several guests. (那個笑話本意是逗人開心，卻冒犯了好幾位客人。)
The market stalls were full of vivid orange scarves and blue bowls. (市場攤位上擺滿鮮豔的橘色圍巾和藍色碗盤。)
As for the broken window, the landlord has promised to fix it. (至於那扇破窗，房東已承諾會修好。)
A low white hedge encloses the neat garden behind the old cottage. (一道低矮的白籬圍住老屋後方整潔的花園。)
The label clearly warns patients never to exceed the stated daily dose. (標籤清楚警告病患絕不可超過標示的每日劑量。)

meaning: n. 供給；補給品 vt. 供應；滿足
example: The village water supply comes from a cold spring above the valley. (村裡的供水來自山谷上方的一處冷泉。)
A change in the weather is on the horizon, according to the fishers. (漁民說天氣即將出現變化。)

meaning: v. 壓縮；壓緊 n. 敷布
example: Farmers compress hay into tight square blocks to store it for winter. (農民把乾草壓成緊實的方塊，儲存起來過冬。)

meaning: n. 興趣；利息；利益 vt. 使感興趣
example: His interest in old clocks began when he found one in the attic. (他對舊鐘的興趣始於在閣樓發現一座鐘。)
She finally overcame her fear of water and now swims every morning. (她終於克服對水的恐懼，現在每天早上都游泳。)
Finishing the coastal path was a real achievement for the small team. (完成這條海岸步道對這個小團隊來說是真正的成就。)
Bats leave their hiding places at dusk and hunt over the pond. (蝙蝠在黃昏離開藏身處，在池塘上方覓食。)
The factory ceased production in June after forty years of steady operation. (這家工廠在營運四十年後於六月停止生產。)

meaning: adj. 可耕作的 n. 耕地
example: Only a narrow strip of arable land lies between the two hills. (兩座山丘之間只有一條狹窄的可耕地。)
The old narrow bridge becomes congested whenever a large slow truck passes. (每當大型慢速卡車經過，這座老舊的窄橋就變得擁擠。)

meaning: v. 分裂；撕裂；分擔 n. 裂口；分裂
example: The group split into two teams to search both sides of the valley. (隊伍分成兩組，搜索山谷兩側。)
There is a distinct difference between the two proposals on housing policy. (這兩項住宅政策提案有明顯的差異。)

meaning: v. 協商；談判；順利通過
example: Union leaders will negotiate with management over pay and working hours next week. (工會領袖下週將與資方協商薪資和工時。)
It seems cruel to keep such a large dog in a small apartment all day. (把這麼大一隻狗整天關在小公寓裡，似乎很殘忍。)
Nordic countries are often praised for their generous parental leave and public childcare. (北歐國家常因優渥的育嬰假和公共托育而受到讚揚。)

meaning: vi. 逗留；流連；緩慢消失
example: The smell of wood smoke lingered in the room long after the fire went out. (爐火熄滅很久之後，房裡仍留著木柴燃燒的氣味。)
During pregnancy, the baby grows inside the womb for around nine months. (懷孕期間，胎兒在子宮內成長約九個月。)
Living near a railway station is advantageous for people who commute to the city. (住在火車站附近，對通勤到市區的人很有利。)

meaning: n. 策略；移動 v. 操縱；移動
example: The company's latest manoeuvre was designed to avoid paying significantly higher taxes. (公司最新的策略是為了避免繳納更高的稅。)
Predatory lending practices have left many low-income families trapped in serious debt. (掠奪性貸款讓許多低收入家庭陷入債務。)

meaning: vi. 談話 n. 相反的事物 adj. 相反的
example: We conversed quietly in the garden while the children played nearby on the grass. (我們在花園裡輕聲交談，孩子們在旁邊玩耍。)
The remark sounded rude, but in context it was clearly meant as a joke. (那句話聽起來很無禮，但從背景來看，顯然只是玩笑。)
She used her entrepreneurial skills to turn a small bakery into a regional chain. (她運用創業技巧，把一家小麵包店變成地區連鎖店。)
A dearth of affordable housing has forced many young workers to leave the city. (平價住宅缺乏，迫使許多年輕勞工離開這座城市。)
My adventurous cousin spent a year hiking through remote mountains in South America. (我愛冒險的表哥花了一年在南美洲的偏遠山區健行。)
The report criticised factories that rely on exploitative labour to keep prices low. (報告批評那些靠剝削勞工來壓低價格的工廠。)
Heavy medical bills can impoverish even families with a steady monthly income. (龐大的醫療費用可以讓即使有穩定收入的家庭陷入貧困。)
Warm air rises through convection, which explains why heaters are placed near the floor. (暖空氣透過對流上升，這說明了暖氣為何裝在地板附近。)
The village sits on a high plateau where temperatures drop sharply at night. (這座村莊位於高原地帶，夜間氣溫驟降。)
Most earthquakes happen when pressure builds up beneath the earth's rocky crust. (大多數地震發生在地殼下方壓力累積的時候。)
Layers of volcanic ash overlie the ancient settlement, making careful excavation difficult. (層層火山灰覆蓋著古代聚落，使挖掘工作十分困難。)
Old plastic pipes become brittle and may crack during very cold weather. (老舊塑膠管會變脆，在天氣很冷時可能裂開。)
The collision between the two buses injured several passengers during the morning rush. (兩輛公車在早晨尖峰時段相撞，造成數名乘客受傷。)
The machine shapes aluminium through extrusion, forcing hot metal through a narrow die. (這部機器以擠壓方式塑造鋁材，把高溫金屬擠過細窄的模具。)
Pumice is so light that it can float on water for months. (浮石非常輕，可以在水面上漂浮好幾個月。)

meaning: adj. 可預測的；墨守成規的
example: His daily routine is so predictable that his colleagues can guess what he will order. (他的日常作息一成不變，同事都能猜到他要點什麼。)
Geological surveys suggest that the area could experience a serious earthquake soon. (地質調查顯示，這個地區可能發生嚴重地震。)
The city aims to halve its carbon emissions within the next fifteen years. (這座城市目標在未來十五年內將碳排放減半。)
Children assimilate new languages more quickly when they hear them every day. (孩子在每天聽到新語言時，吸收得更快。)

meaning: n. 港灣 v. 停泊；隱匿
example: Fishing boats returned to the harbour before the storm reached the coast. (漁船在暴風雨抵達海岸前返回港灣。)

meaning: n. 雜種；混血兒；混合物 adj. 混合的
example: The design is a hybrid of traditional woodwork and modern structural engineering. (這個設計是傳統木工與現代工程的混合物。)
Workers who inhale dust from the construction site must wear protective masks. (吸入工地粉塵的工人必須戴防護口罩。)
The noise from the motorway exceeds seventy decibels, well above the legal limit. (高速公路的噪音超過七十分貝，遠高於法定上限。)

meaning: n. 航行；旅行 v. 航行
example: The voyage across the Pacific took nearly three weeks in calm weather. (這趟橫越太平洋的航行在風平浪靜的天氣下花了將近三週。)
We picked cherries in the orchard and made jam with the leftovers. (我們在果園採櫻桃，並用剩下的櫻桃做果醬。)
Every project budget should include a contingency for unexpected delays and repairs. (每個專案預算都應包含一筆應付突發延誤和維修的備用金。)
She moved to a quieter town for the sake of her health. (為了健康，她搬到一個更安靜的小鎮。)
A warm bath can relieve muscle pain after a long day of walking. (走了一整天後，泡個熱水澡可以緩解肌肉痠痛。)
The government has softened its stance on taxing large foreign technology companies. (政府已軟化對外國科技公司課稅的立場。)

meaning: n. 行為；管理 v. 實施；指揮
example: The committee questioned whether his conduct at the public meeting was acceptable. (委員會質疑他在公開會議上的行為是否恰當。)

meaning: n. 配偶；夥伴 v. 交配
example: He shared a flat with two mates from university for several years. (他和兩個大學夥伴合租公寓好幾年。)

meaning: n./v. 攻擊；抨擊；（疾病）發作
example: The mayor's speech was an attack on critics who opposed the new hospital. (市長的演說抨擊反對新醫院計畫的批評者。)

meaning: vt. 使喪失信譽；使懷疑
example: The newspaper tried to discredit the scientist by questioning her earlier research. (報紙試圖質疑她先前的研究，以使這位科學家失去信譽。)
The island's flora includes several rare species found nowhere else on earth. (這座島的植物群包括幾種地球上其他地方找不到的物種。)

meaning: n. 團；群眾；質量 adj. 大量的 v. 聚集
example: A mass of tourists gathered outside the art gallery before it opened. (一大群遊客在美術館開館前聚集在門外。)
Organisers anticipate that more than ten thousand people will attend the festival. (主辦單位預期會有超過一萬人參加這個節慶。)

meaning: v. 操作；運轉；動手術；經營
example: The plant operates around the clock to meet demand for bottled water. (這座工廠全天候運轉，以滿足瓶裝水的需求。)

meaning: n. 旁道 vt. 繞過
example: A new bypass will carry heavy lorries away from the village centre. (一條新旁道將讓重型卡車遠離村莊中心。)
The leak went undetected for months because the pipe was buried underground. (由於管線埋在地下，漏氣好幾個月都沒被發現。)
Miners descended the shaft in a lift that held only eight people. (礦工搭乘只能容納八人的升降機下到豎井。)
The documentary will be shown on a national television channel next month. (這部紀錄片下個月將在國家電視頻道播出。)
Investigators are still trying to determine the exact cause of the fire. (調查人員仍在努力確定火災的原因。)
A handful of large firms dominate the market for household cleaning products. (少數幾家大公司支配了家用清潔用品市場。)
She was instrumental in persuading the council to fund the new library. (她在說服市議會資助新圖書館一事上發揮了關鍵作用。)
